source.adm2: geoBoundaries gbOpen ADM2 (commit 9469f09) via NeoFeoda cache, with OSM/ODbL overrides for ITA, DEU, FRA, ESP, PHL, BGD, ARE and RUS (St. Petersburg)

lookup.indexEntry: { id, name, bbox: [minLng, minLat, maxLng, maxLat] }
lookup.algorithm: resolveCountry: bbox-prefilter index/adm0.json -> PIP candidate geo/adm0/{ISO3}.geojson -> nearest-edge fallback. resolveRegion(level): resolveCountry, then bbox-prefilter index/adm{level}/{ISO3}.json -> PIP candidate geo -> nearest-edge fallback; if the level has no data for the country, fall back up (adm2->adm1->adm0).

cdn.note: Replace {ref} with a git tag (e.g. v1.0.0) to pin. Replace {ISO3}/{id} per the paths above.
